message.content:
A magazine cover features a lime green background with a red vertical border on the left. At the top, white text reads “PENGAKUAN PEREMPUAN EKS TERORIS / NAFAS BARU BISNIS PARIWISATA”. Below, the word “TEMPO” is written in large, pale green capital letters, with “50 Tahun!” in a cursive font underneath. Bold black text follows: “PATGULIPAT MAKELAR PEJABAT”. A smaller black text block details allegations regarding the Ministry of Village, Development of Disadvantaged Regions, and Transmigration.

The central illustration shows two textured, orange-toned hands in a green-suited sleeve holding a white, bowl-like object shaped like a halved coconut. A black straw and an orange slice garnish the rim. The interior of the bowl contains the circular logo for “KEMENTERIAN DESA, PEMBANGUNAN DAERAH TERTINGGAL, DAN TRANSMIGRASI,” featuring red geometric shapes, green leaf-like forms, and blue curved lines. In the bottom left, text indicates "12-18 APRIL 2021", the price "RP 45.000", and an ISSN. A QR code and a barcode are also visible at the bottom.
